form.description: code_fix: repair existing behaviour; feature: new behaviour or page; test_suite: the deliverable is a test suite; fix_and_report: investigate, report fields and fix source; answer_only: only submit.json fields, no source change; report_only: incident report, source changes out of scope

summary.description: one or two sentences: what has to be delivered

grading.description: every scoring rule the item or MVS states, one entry per rule

aspect.description: mvs_replay: organizers rerun the issued MVS test; hidden_tests: organizer tests on the submitted source; browser_replay: a scenario is replayed in a browser on the built app; team_tests_pass: the team's own tests are run and must pass; detection: the team's tests are run against broken builds and must fail there; typecheck: the type check is graded; exact_fields: reported fields are compared exactly; completion_order: points depend on finishing order or time; existing_tests: issued tests must keep passing; other: any other scoring rule

quote.description: verbatim sentence or phrase copied from the item or its MVS that says this

sourceFiles.description: source files the item names explicitly; [] when it names none

path.description: path the item names, as written

testLocation.description: directory or file pattern the item requires for new tests, or null

answerFields.description: fields of submit.json the team must fill, besides status, evidenceFiles, testResults and the engineering/incident record

exact.description: true when the item says the field is compared exactly

evidence.description: every evidence file the item or its MVS requires by name

file.description: file name under answers/<ID>/evidence/, exactly as required

beforeFix.description: true when it must be captured on the unfixed code

scenarios.description: every testResults id of the template, [] when the template has none

constraints.description: things the item forbids or fixes (keep handler names, tests in new files, out of scope...)
